cues.en: Nearly all of the models that we have trained and data sets that we have used so far in the course have been pretty computationally manageable.
cues.zh: 目前課程訓練過的模型，以及使用過的資料集，幾乎都在可輕鬆處理的計算規模內。

cues.en: So we had no problem running these on the CPUs that are available by default through Google Colab.
cues.zh: 所以用 Google Colab 預設提供的 CPU 執行，都沒問題。

cues.en: However, we are quickly getting to a point in the course where the data sets will be larger and the
cues.zh: 不過課程很快會進入資料集更大，

cues.en: models will be also larger and more complicated, and therefore it becomes advantageous to switch to GPUs or graphical processing units.
cues.zh: 模型也更大、更複雜的階段，這時改用 GPU，也就是圖形處理器，就有好處。

cues.en: Let's begin with a just a brief overview of the difference between the CPU central processing unit and GPU graphics processing unit.
cues.zh: 先簡短概覽 CPU，也就是中央處理器，與 GPU 圖形處理器的差別。

cues.en: So the idea of a central processing unit is that it's supposed to be a general purpose processor.
cues.zh: 中央處理器的概念，是作為通用處理器。

cues.en: It's designed for interactive use, and most of what you do on a computer is interactive.
cues.zh: 它為互動使用而設計，而你在電腦上做的大部分事情，都具有互動性。

cues.en: You are opening and closing programs and files and saving and changing things.
cues.zh: 例如開啟、關閉程式與檔案，以及儲存、修改內容。

cues.en: On the other hand, CPUs process things serially as opposed to parallel.
cues.zh: 另一方面，CPU 以循序方式處理，而不是平行處理。

cues.en: So CPUs are serial processing devices.
cues.zh: 所以 CPU 是循序處理裝置。

cues.en: They are fast, of course, and every year they get faster.
cues.zh: 當然，它們很快，而且每年都更快。

cues.en: And they're also limited to a relatively small number of cores.
cues.zh: 但核心數量相對有限。

cues.en: Of course, you know, this also doubles every couple of years, but but relative to GPUs, the number of cores is small.
cues.zh: 當然，核心數也每隔幾年增加一倍，但相較 GPU，仍然較少。

cues.en: So then we have the GPUs over here.
cues.zh: 接著是這邊的 GPU。

cues.en: These are custom design.
cues.zh: 它們經過專門設計。

cues.en: They are hardware designed for matrix multiplication.
cues.zh: 硬體是為矩陣乘法而設計。

cues.en: And that is pretty neat because deep learning is basically nothing more than just lots of matrix multiplications.
cues.zh: 這很棒，因為深度學習基本上就是大量矩陣乘法。

cues.en: The idea of a GPU is to break up a large task into lots of tiny little pieces.
cues.zh: GPU 的概念，是把大任務拆成很多非常小的部分。

cues.en: Each piece gets to be run on its own tiny little core in parallel, and then those pieces can be put back together.
cues.zh: 每個小部分，由自己的小核心平行執行，之後再組合回來。

cues.en: Now, the thing is that using a GPU requires some additional software.
cues.zh: 不過，使用 GPU 需要額外軟體。

cues.en: It requires some additional settings, and it also requires some additional code to interface with the GPU and to move data back and forth between the GPU.
cues.zh: 也需要額外設定，以及與 GPU 互動、來回移動資料的額外程式碼。

cues.en: So these are just some words here.
cues.zh: 剛才只有文字說明。

cues.en: I have now a picture to show you that highlights the overview and the distinction between the CPU and the GPU.
cues.zh: 現在用圖片，概覽並凸顯 CPU 與 GPU 的差異。

cues.en: So you can see the CPU has large nodes for control and cache.
cues.zh: 可以看到，CPU 有很大的控制與快取區塊。

cues.en: And this is of course what we want in a CPU, because we want to be able to interact with the CPU in real time and control a lot of the computations.
cues.zh: 這正是 CPU 需要的，因為我們想即時互動，控制很多計算。

cues.en: And we also need to swap things in memory, we need to store things in memory and so on.
cues.zh: 也需要在記憶體中交換、儲存資料等等。

cues.en: As you.
cues.zh: 這裡的 ALU，

cues.en: Here stands for arithmetic logical unit.
cues.zh: 代表算術邏輯單元。

cues.en: These are like you know, you can think of each one of these things as being like a tiny solar powered calculator.
cues.zh: 可以把每個想成一個小型太陽能計算機。

cues.en: You know, they're kind of dumb, they're kind of simplistic, but they are fast and they just implement some basic mathematical processes.
cues.zh: 有點笨、很簡單，但速度快，能執行基本數學運算。

cues.en: So the idea of a CPU is that, you know, you're using these two nodes a lot, and these two also get used here.
cues.zh: CPU 的概念是，這兩個區塊用得很多，另外這兩個也會用到。

cues.en: You see the GPU, you can see pretty much the entire thing is a lot of Alus.
cues.zh: 再看 GPU，幾乎整個都是大量 ALU。

cues.en: So a lot of arithmetic logical units.
cues.zh: 也就是很多算術邏輯單元。

cues.en: Of course there are control and cache units here as well because we do need to, you know, send instructions and swap things in memory and so on.
cues.zh: 當然，也有控制與快取單元，因為仍然需要傳送指令、在記憶體中交換資料等等。

cues.en: But the whole purpose of the GPU is to implement lots and lots and lots of little mathematical computations, mostly matrix algebra.
cues.zh: 但 GPU 的整體目的，是執行大量小型數學運算，主要是矩陣代數。

cues.en: So the way to think about the difference between a CPU and a GPU is that the CPU is like the brains, and the GPU is like the brawn.
cues.zh: 所以可以把 CPU 想成大腦，把 GPU 想成肌肉。

cues.en: So the CPU is smart and flexible, and it can implement many different kinds of operations.
cues.zh: CPU 聰明、有彈性，能執行很多不同種類的操作。

cues.en: And the GPU is just, you know, it's extremely fast, it's very powerful, but it doesn't really do a whole lot on its own.
cues.zh: GPU 則非常快、非常有力，但單靠自己做不了太多事。

cues.en: It's not very smart all on its own.
cues.zh: 它本身不算聰明。

cues.en: So therefore the idea of using CPUs and GPUs in deep learning is that all of the interactive stuff,
cues.zh: 因此在深度學習中使用 CPU 與 GPU 的概念是，所有互動工作，

cues.en: like setting up your network and transforming the data and all this kind of stuff, this happens here on the CPU.
cues.zh: 例如設定網路、轉換資料等等，都在 CPU 上進行。

cues.en: And when you get to doing the training, which is really, you know, that's really just a lot of matrix multiplications, all of that stuff gets farmed out to the GPU.
cues.zh: 到了訓練，也就是大量矩陣乘法時，再交給 GPU。

cues.en: The way this works conceptually is that you set up everything.
cues.zh: 概念上，是先設定好所有東西。

cues.en: So the models, the training protocol, the data, the normalization, everything gets set up on the CPU.
cues.zh: 模型、訓練流程、資料、正規化，全部在 CPU 上準備。

cues.en: And then you have to transfer the model and also transfer all the data to the GPU.
cues.zh: 然後把模型與資料都傳到 GPU。

cues.en: And then the GPU does all the matrix multiplications and so on.
cues.zh: GPU 負責矩陣乘法等等。

cues.en: And then you have to transfer the output of the model all the processing back to the CPU.
cues.zh: 接著再把模型輸出與處理結果，傳回 CPU。

cues.en: So you have to constantly do this transfer stuff.
cues.zh: 所以必須不斷傳來傳去。

cues.en: The GPU cannot process information that is sitting on the CPU.
cues.zh: GPU 無法處理還放在 CPU 上的資訊。

cues.en: Likewise, if you want to access and interact with the information that's on the GPU.
cues.zh: 同樣地，如果想存取、操作 GPU 上的資訊，

cues.en: You cannot do that directly.
cues.zh: 也不能直接做。

cues.en: Instead, you have to transfer it back into the CPU.
cues.zh: 必須先傳回 CPU。

cues.en: Now, to be clear, I don't mean to like, scare you off or anything.
cues.zh: 先說清楚，我不是想嚇你。

cues.en: This is not a big deal.
cues.zh: 這不是什麼大問題。

cues.en: This is fairly straightforward, but each one of these steps is an additional thing to add to your code.
cues.zh: 做法相當直接，但每個步驟都需要多寫一些程式。

cues.zh: 每多加一項，就增加程式複雜度，也增加出錯風險，或至少花更多時間。
